profileLabel: Speech-restrictive on disinformation and deepfakes (low confidence); mixed economics
summary: Bulacan 6th District representative with 387 principal-authored bills. Authored penalties for false social media content, accountability of social media users and a ban on deepfake technology. Also authored senior and PWD discounts, fuel excise suspension, gasoline and diesel as prime commodities, pro bono doctor tax incentives and a higher income tax exemption ceiling.
caveat: Only 10 rubric bills surfaced from 387. Economic score nets price-regulation and discount bills against tax cuts.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored senior and PWD purchase discounts (-2) and listing gasoline and diesel as prime commodities (-2, price regulation), against fuel excise suspension and pro bono tax incentives (+1) and a higher income tax exemption (-1).
